# Environment Setup

```{r setup}
# Packages
library(rprojroot)
library(tidyverse)
library(pomp)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
library(doRNG)
library(patchwork)
library(GGally)
library(lubridate)
library(formattable)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(htmltools)

# Set Random Seed
nb_name <-  "Cholera modelling with compartmental models and pomp - no disaster, new data"
seed <- sum(sapply(str_split(nb_name, pattern = "", simplify = TRUE), FUN = utf8ToInt))

# Parallel Computing
n_cores <- parallel::detectCores()
registerDoParallel(n_cores)
registerDoRNG(seed)

# Folder Structure
root <- has_file("cholera-surveillance.Rproj")$make_fix_file()
raw_data_dir <- root("data/raw")
proc_data_dir <- root("data/processed")
output_models_dir <- root("models_output/models")
dir.create(output_models_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
output_params_dir <- root("models_output/parameters")
dir.create(output_params_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
img_dir <- root("images")
dir.create(img_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
src_dir <- root("src")

# Local Packages
model_builder <- new.env()
source(file.path(src_dir, "model_builder_fix_param_no_buffer.R"), local=model_builder)
global_searches <- new.env()
source(file.path(src_dir, "run_global_searches.R"), local=global_searches)
NegBin <- new.env()
source(file.path(src_dir, "optimize_arnb.R"), local=NegBin)
viz <- new.env()
source(file.path(src_dir, "viz.R"), local=viz)
```

# Functions

```{r}
symlog <- function(x) {
  symlogx <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(x)) {
    if (is.na(x[i])) {
      symlogx[i] <- NA
    }
    else if (abs(x[i]) < 1e-5) {
      symlogx[i] <- x[i]
    }
    else if (x[i] > 0) {
      symlogx[i] <- log(x[i])
    }
    else {
      symlogx[i] <- -log(-x[i])
    }
  }
  return(symlogx)
}

custom_color_tile <- function(...) {
  formatter("span",
    style = function(x) style(
      display = "block",
      padding = "0 4px",
      "border-radius" = "4px",
      "background-color" = csscolor(gradient(log(as.numeric(x) - min(as.numeric(x)) + 1), ...))))
}

custom_color_bar <- function(color = "lightblue", min_width = 30, fun = "proportion", ...) {
  fun <- match.fun(fun)
  formatter("span",
    style = function(x) style(
      display = "inline-block",
      direction = "rtl",
      "unicode-bidi" = "plaintext",
      "border-radius" = "4px",
      "padding-right" = "2px",
      "background-color" = csscolor(color),
      width = percent(fun(as.numeric(x) - min(as.numeric(x)) + min_width, ...))
    ))
}


normalize <- function(x) {
  (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
}
```

## Cholera

```{r}
df_reports <- (
  read_csv(
    # file.path(proc_data_dir, "uvira_chol_cov_week_20250430.csv", fsep = "/"),
    # file.path(proc_data_dir, "uvira_chol_cov_week_20250501.csv", fsep = "/"),
    # file.path(proc_data_dir, "uvira_chol_cov_week_20250505.csv", fsep = "/"),
    # file.path(proc_data_dir, "uvira_chol_cov_week_20250512.csv", fsep = "/"),
    # file.path(proc_data_dir, "uvira_chol_cov_week_20250711.csv", fsep = "/"),
    file.path(proc_data_dir, "uvira_chol_cov_week_20250725.csv", fsep = "/"),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  %>% mutate(
    idps = replace_na(idps, 0) / 7,  # we need to convert to daily numbers
    dis = num_disaster_affected / max(num_disaster_affected),
    # covid_lagged = lag(covid_deaths_per_million, n = 2, default = 0),
    covid_lagged = lag(covid_cases_per_million, n = 2, default = 0),
    covid_roll = zoo::rollmean(covid_lagged, k = 3, fill = 0, align = "right"),
    covid = covid_roll / max(covid_roll, na.rm = TRUE),
    cov = lead(normalize(cov), n = 1, default = NA),  # Normalize and shift the covariate back by one week
    vacc = if_else(
      date < "2021-01-01",
      vacc * 0.63,
      vacc * 0.725
    )
  )
  # %>% merge(
  #   df_pop_mov,
  #   by = "date",
  #   all.x = TRUE
  # )
  # %>% mutate(
  #   idps = replace_na(pop_mov, 0) / 7
  # )
  %>% na.omit()
  %>% select(
    date,
    reports,
    rdt_confirmed,
    idps,
    dis,
    covid,
    cov,
    vacc
  )
)
```

## Covariates

```{r}
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 8

min_year <- min(year(df_reports$date))
max_year <- max(year(df_reports$date))
years <- seq(min_year, max_year, by = 1)
num_years <- length(years)

base_plot <- (
  ggplot(data = df_reports)
  + theme(
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = c(rep("black", num_years + 1), rep(NA, num_years + 1)))
  )
  + scale_x_date(
      breaks = c(as.Date(paste0(seq(2020, 2025, 1), "-01-01")), as.Date(paste0(seq(2020, 2025, 1), "-07-01"))),
      labels = c(rep(c(""), 6), rep(seq(2020, 2025, 1))),
  )
)

p1 <- (
  base_plot
  + geom_line(
      aes(x = date, y = reports),
      color = "firebrick",
      linewidth = 1.2
  )
  + labs(
    x = "Date", 
    y = "Suspected\ncholera cases"
  )
)

p2 <- (
  base_plot
  + geom_line(
    aes(x = date, y = cov),
    color = "turquoise4",
    linewidth = 1.2
  )
  + labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Force of\ninfection (norm.)"
  )
)

p3 <- (
  base_plot
  + geom_line(
    aes(x = date, y = covid),
    color = "darkorchid",
    linewidth = 1.2
  )
  + labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "COVID deaths\n(3-week, norm.)"
  )
)

p4 <- (
  base_plot
  + geom_line(
    aes(x = date, y = vacc),
    color = "orange",
    linewidth = 1.2
  )
  + labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Vaccinations"
  )
)

p5 <- (
  base_plot
  + geom_line(
    aes(x = date, y = idps),
    color = "forestgreen",
    linewidth = 1.2
  )
  + labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "IDPs"
  )
)

(
  (p1 / p2 / p3 / p4 / p5)
  + plot_layout(
    axes = "collect"
  )
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(img_dir, "model_inputs.png"),
  width = 6,
  height = 8,
  units = "in"
)
```

# Computational Parameters

```{r}
reset_data <- TRUE
rw.sd_rp <- 0.05
rw.sd_ivp <- 0.2
cooling.fraction.50_tune <- 0.5 # perturbations at the end of 50 IF2 iterations are this fraction smaller than they are at first.
cooling.fraction.50_last <- 0.1 
run_level <- 2

Np <- switch(run_level, 100, 1e3, 5e3)
Nmif <- switch(run_level, 20, 100, 400)
Nreps <- switch(run_level, 10, 20, 100)
Nreps_eval <- switch(run_level, 2, 10, 20)
Nsim <- switch(run_level, 50, 100, 500)
profile_pts <- switch(run_level, 3, 5, 30)
profile_Nreps <- switch(run_level, 2, 3, 10)


# Np <- switch(run_level, 200, 1e3, 5e3)
# Nmif <- switch(run_level, 50, 200, 400)
# Nreps_eval <- switch(run_level, 4, 10, 20)
# Nreps_local <- switch(run_level, 10, 20, 40)
# Nreps_global <- switch(run_level, 20, 40, 100)
# Nsim <- switch(run_level, 50, 100, 500)
# Napproxbayes_p <- switch(run_level, 10000, 20000, 40000)
# Nbayes_iter <- switch(run_level, 5000, 10000, 40000)
# profile_pts <- switch(run_level, 3, 5, 30)
# profile_Nreps <- switch(run_level, 2, 3, 10)
```

# Parameters

From: https://databank.worldbank.org/reports.aspx?source=2&series=SP.DYN.CBRT.IN&country= Birth and death rates are per person and per DAY (all rates in the model are daily rates). Note that one unit of time is one year and each time step is 1/52 so all times and rates need to be scaled to this. For example, an infectious period of 10 days needs to be expressed as the number of units (1/52): (10/7) \* (1/52). For the same reason birth and death rates that are collected as rate per year they only need to be scaled by the number of people but left as year estimates. The time step 1/52 is then applied during the pomp step.

```{r}
custom_colors = c(
  "#f2fdff", 
  "#65E3ff", 
  "#ffdcd5", 
  "#ff7f7f", 
  # "#71CA97", 
  "#42A74D",
  "#DeF7E9"
)


# Birth and death rates
# From: https://databank.worldbank.org/reports.aspx?source=2&series=SP.DYN.CBRT.IN&country=

df_dem <- tibble(
  date = df_reports$date[seq(1, length(df_reports$date), length.out=10)],
  deathrate = c(10.1, 9.9, 9.6, 9.4, 9.5, 9.7, 9.4, 9.4, 9.4, 9.4) / (1000),
  birthrate = c(43.5, 43.4, 43, 42.7, 42.3, 42, 41.7, 41.3, 41, 40.7) * 1.05 / (1000) # rates are adjusted to better reflect data that Andrew shared
)
```

# Full model data

```{r}
df_full <- (
  df_reports
  %>% merge(
    df_dem,
    by="date",
    all.x=TRUE
  )
  %>% mutate(
    date = seq(-1, n()-2, by = 1) / 52,
    birthrate = zoo::na.approx(birthrate, na.rm=FALSE),  # We interpolated the rates
    deathrate = zoo::na.approx(deathrate, na.rm=FALSE)
  )
)
```

# 2. With Covariate Modulation

```{r}
output_model_name_2 <- "uvira_multioutbreak_fixed_param_2.rda"
output_params_path_2 <- file.path(output_params_dir, "uvira_multioutbreak_fixed_param_2.csv")
```

## Model Definition

```{r}
m_2 <- model_builder$build_pomp_model(
  data = df_full,
  use_cov = TRUE,
  use_cov_intercept = FALSE,
  use_separate_recovery = TRUE
)
```

## Global Search

### Search Parameters

#### Search Steps

```{r}
rw.sd_2 <- rw_sd(
  s_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  e_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  a_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  i_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  ra_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  ri_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  # r_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  b_cov = rw.sd_rp,
  eps_A = rw.sd_rp,
  # mu_ras = rw.sd_rp,
  # mu_ris = rw.sd_rp,
  delta_rs = rw.sd_rp,
  tau = rw.sd_rp,
  rho = rw.sd_rp,
  sigmaSE = rw.sd_rp
)
```

#### Search Box

```{r}
sigmaSE_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.003, max = 0.2)
s_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
e_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
a_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
i_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
ra_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
ri_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
# r_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
b_cov_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 2, max = 5000)
eps_A_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
# mu_ras_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-3, max = 300)
# mu_ris_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.05, max = 10)
delta_rs_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0, max = 10)
rho_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-4, max = 0.99)
tau_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-4, max = 5)

guess_points_2 <- as.data.frame(cbind(
  sigmaSE = sigmaSE_guesses,
  s_0 = s_0_guesses,
  e_0 = e_0_guesses,
  a_0 = a_0_guesses,
  i_0 = i_0_guesses,
  ra_0 = ra_0_guesses,
  ri_0 = ri_0_guesses,
  # r_0 = r_0_guesses,
  b_cov = b_cov_guesses,
  eps_A = eps_A_guesses,
  # mu_ras = mu_ras_guesses,
  # mu_ris = mu_ris_guesses,
  delta_rs = delta_rs_guesses,
  tau = tau_guesses,
  rho = rho_guesses
))
```

### Run model

```{r}
model_params <- coef(m_2)
fixed_params <- model_params[!(names(model_params) %in% names(guess_points_2))]

stew(
  file = output_model_name_2, 
  dir = output_models_dir,
  expr = {
    start <- Sys.time()
    m_global_2 <- foreach (guess=iter(guess_points_2, "row"), .combine=c) %dopar% {
      (
        m_2
        %>% mif2(
          Np=Np,
          Nmif=Nmif,
          params=c(fixed_params, unlist(guess)),
          cooling.fraction.50 = cooling.fraction.50_tune,
          rw.sd = rw.sd_2
        )
        %>% mif2(cooling.fraction.50 = cooling.fraction.50_last)
      )
    }
    loglik_global_2 <- (
      foreach(
        i=1:Nreps,
        .combine=rbind
      ) %dopar% {
        logmeanexp(
          replicate(
            Nreps_eval,
            logLik(pfilter(m_2, params=coef(m_global_2[[i]]), Np=1000))
          ),
          se=TRUE
        )
      }
    )
    end <- Sys.time()
    cat("Run time of global iterated particle filter: ", as.integer(round(difftime(end, start, units='mins'))), " minutes")
  }
)
```

### Collect and Save Results

```{r}
df_results_2 <- global_searches$collect_and_save_loglik(
  model_search = m_global_2,
  loglik_values = loglik_global_2,
  out_filename = output_params_path_2,
  reset_data = reset_data
)
```

### Diagnostic

#### Convergence

```{r}
(
  m_global_2
  %>% traces()
  %>% melt()
  %>% ggplot(
    aes(
      x=iteration,
      y=value,
      group=.L1,
      color=factor(.L1)
    )
  )
  + geom_line()
  + guides(color="none")
  + facet_wrap(~name, scales="free_y")
)
```

#### Summary

```{r}
coef(m_global_2[[which.max(loglik_global_2[,1])]])
```

```{r}
summary(df_results_2$log_lik, digits=5)
```

#### Pair plot

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-asp: 1
viz$plot_pairs(guess_points_2, df_results_2, log_lik_diff = 3)
dev.print(
  device = png, 
  filename = file.path(img_dir, "pair_plot_no_int_2.png"),
  width = 700, 
  height = 700
)
```

#### Simulations from best model

```{r}
sims_best_2 <- (
  global_searches$simulate_best_model(
    m_global_2,
    loglik_global_2,
    nsim = Nsim
  )
  %>% mutate(
    date = df_reports$date[1] + weeks(round(date * 52))
  )
)
```

##### Compartments

```{r}
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 6

viz$plot_compartments_sims(df_reports, sims_best_2, c("N", "S", "E"))
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(img_dir, "compartments_sim_no_int_2.png"),
  width = 5,
  height = 6,
  units = "in"
)
```

##### Individual plots

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6
viz$plot_data_and_sample_sims(
  df_reports,
  target = "reports",
  sims = sims_best_2
)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(img_dir, "ind_sim_no_int_2.png"),
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  units = "in"
)
```

##### Aggregate plot

```{r}

#| fig-height: 3
sims_best_stats_2 <- global_searches$calculate_sim_stats(sims_best_2)
(
  viz$plot_data_and_summary_sims(
    df_reports,
    target = "reports",
    sims = sims_best_stats_2
  )
  + labs(title = "No interventions")
  # + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 210))
)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(img_dir, "agg_sim_no_int_2.png"),
  width = 7,
  height = 3,
```

```{r}
          params=c(fixed_params, unlist(guess)),
          cooling.fraction.50 = cooling.fraction.50_tune,

        )

      )

        )
      }
    )

)
```

# 12. With Separate Recovered, COVID

```{r}
output_model_name_12 <- "uvira_multioutbreak_fixed_param_12.rda"
output_params_path_12 <- file.path(output_params_dir, "uvira_multioutbreak_fixed_param_12.csv")
```

## Model Definition

```{r}
m_12 <- model_builder$build_pomp_model(
  data = df_full,
  use_cov = TRUE,
  use_cov_intercept = FALSE,
  use_separate_recovery = TRUE,
  add_covid = TRUE
)
```

## Global Search

### Search Parameters

#### Search Steps

```{r}
rw.sd_12 <- rw_sd(
  s_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  e_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  a_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  i_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  ra_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  ri_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  # r_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  sigmaSE = rw.sd_rp,
  b_cov = rw.sd_rp,
  eps_A = rw.sd_rp,
  b_covid = rw.sd_rp,
  # mu_ras = rw.sd_rp,
  # mu_ris = rw.sd_rp,
  delta_rs = rw.sd_rp,
  rho = rw.sd_rp,
  tau = rw.sd_rp
)
```

#### Search Box

```{r}
s_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
e_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
a_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
i_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
ra_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
ri_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
# r_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
b_cov_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 2, max = 5000)
eps_A_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
b_covid_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.001, max = 1)
# mu_ras_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-3, max = 100)
# mu_ris_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.05, max = 10)
delta_rs_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0, max = 10)
rho_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 1)
tau_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-4, max = 5)
sigmaSE_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.2)


guess_points_12 <- as.data.frame(cbind(
  s_0 = s_0_guesses,
  e_0 = e_0_guesses,
  a_0 = a_0_guesses,
  i_0 = i_0_guesses,
  ra_0 = ra_0_guesses,
  ri_0 = ri_0_guesses,
  # r_0 = r_0_guesses,
  sigmaSE = sigmaSE_guesses,
  b_cov = b_cov_guesses,
  eps_A = eps_A_guesses,
  b_covid = b_covid_guesses,
  # mu_ras = mu_ras_guesses,
  # mu_ris = mu_ris_guesses,
  delta_rs = delta_rs_guesses,
  tau = tau_guesses,
  rho = rho_guesses
))
```

### Run model

```{r}
model_params <- coef(m_12)
fixed_params <- model_params[!(names(model_params) %in% names(guess_points_12))]

stew(
  file = output_model_name_12, 
  dir = output_models_dir,
  expr = {
    start <- Sys.time()
    m_global_12 <- foreach (guess=iter(guess_points_12, "row"), .combine=c) %dopar% {
      (
        m_12
        %>% mif2(
          Np=Np,
          Nmif=Nmif,
          params=c(fixed_params, unlist(guess)),
          cooling.fraction.50 = cooling.fraction.50_tune,
          rw.sd = rw.sd_12
        )
        %>% mif2(cooling.fraction.50 = cooling.fraction.50_last)
      )
    }
    loglik_global_12 <- (
      foreach(
        i=1:Nreps,
        .combine=rbind 
      ) %dopar% {
        logmeanexp(
          replicate(
            Nreps_eval,
            logLik(pfilter(m_12, params=coef(m_global_12[[i]]), Np=1000))
          ),
          se=TRUE
        )
      }
    )
    end <- Sys.time()
    cat("Run time of global iterated particle filter: ", as.integer(round(difftime(end, start, units='mins'))), " minutes")
  }
)
```

### Collect and Save Results

```{r}
df_results_12 <- global_searches$collect_and_save_loglik(
  model_search = m_global_12,
  loglik_values = loglik_global_12,
  out_filename = output_params_path_12,
  reset_data = reset_data
)
```

# Benchmarks

## Negative binomial IID Model

```{r}
nb_lik <- function(tau) {
  -sum(
    dnbinom(
      as.vector(obs(m_13)),
      size = exp(tau[1]),
      prob = exp(tau[2]),
      log = TRUE
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
nb_mle <- optim(c(0, -5), nb_lik)
```

```{r}
nb_mle$par
```

```{r}
-nb_mle$value
```

## Negative Binomial AR1

```{r}
arnb <- NegBin$arnb_fit(
  data = as.vector(obs(m_13)),
  start_vals = c(20, 0.5, 1),
)
```

```{r}
arnb$theta
```

```{r}
arnb$ll
```

## ARMA model

```{r}
log_y <- log(as.vector(obs(m_13)) + 1)
arma_fit <- arima(
  log_y,
  order=c(2, 0, 2),
  seasonal=list(
    order=c(1, 0, 1),
    period=1
  )
)
```

```{r}
arma_fit$loglik - sum(log_y)
```

```{r}
arma_fit$coef
```

# Collect results

```{r}

lls <- list(
  loglik_global_2[,1],
  loglik_global_6[,1],
  loglik_global_7[,1],
  loglik_global_9[,1],
  loglik_global_10[,1],
  loglik_global_11[,1],
  loglik_global_12[,1],
  loglik_global_13[,1]
)

mech_models <- list(
  m_global_2[[which.max(loglik_global_2[,1])]],
  m_global_6[[which.max(loglik_global_6[,1])]],
  m_global_7[[which.max(loglik_global_7[,1])]],
  m_global_9[[which.max(loglik_global_9[,1])]],
  m_global_10[[which.max(loglik_global_10[,1])]],
  m_global_11[[which.max(loglik_global_11[,1])]],
  m_global_12[[which.max(loglik_global_12[,1])]],
  m_global_13[[which.max(loglik_global_13[,1])]]
)

model_names <- c(
  # paste0("m_", 1:length(lls)),
  paste0("m_", c(2, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13)),
  # "nb_iid",
  "nb_ar1",
  "SARIMA"
)

num_params <- sapply(mech_models, function(x) length(coef(x)) - 4)
num_params <- c(
  num_params, 
  # 2, 
  3, 
  7
)
lls_best <- sapply(lls, max)
lls_best <- c(
  lls_best, 
  # -nb_mle$value, 
  arnb$ll, 
  arma_fit$loglik - sum(log_y)
)
aics <- -2 * lls_best + 2 * num_params
delta_aics <- aics - min(aics)

df_summary <- (
  data.frame(
    Model = model_names,
    Log_Likelihood = round(lls_best),
    Parameter_Number = num_params,
    deltaAIC = round(delta_aics),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
)
```

```{r}
df_summary
```
